bugs.title: Press during open valve is lost, not queued
bugs.description: scanStart() only calls openZone() when !zoneOpen (line 49), and held is updated to the current level every settled scan (line 53). bugs.title: Valve pulse truncated to 0 ms when press straddles millis() rollover
bugs.description: openValve() at line 21 sets valveDeadline = millis() + OPEN_MS, which wraps to a small value when the press occurs near the millis() rollover. deadlineReached() at line 34 compares with a plain `millis() >= valveDeadline`, so immediately after the wrap the wrapped deadline is already satisfied and loop() closes the valve on the next iteration. Measured evidence: "pulse from 31 ms lasted 0 ms, expected 400 ± 150 ms". 1 of 2 pulse(s) had the wrong length: pulse from 31 ms lasted 0 ms, expected 400 ± 150 ms.

bugs.title: Relay toggles far more than twice per 5 s window
bugs.description: drive() at lines 44-48 recomputes D6 from `running && !held()` on every loop pass, so each bounce or release of D3 produces an extra LOW->HIGH->LOW edge on D6 with no debounce or edge limiting. The measured evidence shows D6 toggled 16 times in the 5000 ms window starting at 5.00 s (limit 2) during button bounce, and 12 times in the window starting at 5.00 s when the hold is released mid-run. Nothing in loop() (lines 59-74) counts or rate-limits D6 transitions, so the 2-toggle-per-5000 ms limit is never enforced.
